description: Get a short-lived upload URL for an image, video or audio reference file (png, jpg, webp, gif up to 20MB; mp4, mov up to 100MB; mp3, wav, m4a up to 25MB). PUT the raw bytes to upload_url with the same content-type, then use public_url as image_urls, video_url or audio_urls. Use this when you can run a shell command; the stdio server also offers upload_reference for local paths. Files are kept about 48 hours. Free; requires a positive balance.

content_length.description: Exact file size in bytes (e.g. from `wc -c < file`)

name: create_upload_url
title: Get an upload URL for a reference file
